sn22.57:8.1: Those ascetics and brahmins who have directly known feeling in this way—and its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation;
sn22.57:8.2: its gratification, drawback, and escape—and are practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding feeling: they are practicing well.
sn22.57:8.3: Those who practice well have a footing in this teaching and training.
sn22.57:9.1: Those ascetics and brahmins who have directly known feeling in this way …
sn22.57:9.2: For them there is no cycle of rebirths to be found.
